title: Prove exact Walsh tape cut ranks and one-head travel floors (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For H_N on m independent columns, a one-head linear tape machine carrying one field register has these layout-dependent travel floors:

```text
address-major H_N tensor I_m:  (Nm)^2/2 unit moves
column-major I_m tensor H_N:   m N^2/2 + 2(m-1) unit moves
N=8, m=4:                     512 versus 134 lower bounds
```

The package proves every spatial cut rank and a closed-form bound for every positive register capacity s, over any field of characteristic other than two. The extra inter-column travel is charged even where communication rank is zero. These are lower bounds, not optimal schedules. With fixed N and s, address-major storage cannot have linear-in-m travel in the stated machine.

The communication-rank method is classical. The new result is the exact pair of layout profiles and their one-head travel conversion. This is an original side result for `precision_tape`, with an explicitly changed card scope. It neither audits a predecessor nor discharges the selected multitape assumption. No new κ or selected-frontier change. Credit zxv #5441 for the representation-versus-physical-cost distinction, ToikY #4192 for the separate sequential compiler, and the classical linear-communication/Walsh background cited in the README. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19226107).

## Evidence

- Before: algebraic column repetition alone supplies no travel invoice in this restricted machine. After: an all-size linear-span proof gives both exact layout profiles and their register-dependent movement floors.
- Exact Fraction elimination checks both directional ranks at 568 cuts in 32 literal matrices; direct summation checks 224 register-dependent closed forms.
- Eighteen local butterfly programs execute 612 gates and 2,358 unit moves, restore an arbitrary dirty register, satisfy both directional demands at 150 cuts, and pass full inverse-product checks. Eleven controls cover malformed dimensions, layout and travel omissions, dirty restoration and gate changes.
- Both warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass, locally timed at 0.254 and 0.307 seconds. These are check durations, not a speed comparison. Both registered commands pass; committed-byte and source-history checks pass on `f7ecabe8e04738ee4fd6ac934363ca2c307d85b2`. The worktree is clean.

Local environment: CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/walsh-tape-cut-area/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/walsh-tape-cut-area/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/walsh-tape-cut-area
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/walsh-tape-cut-area --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_WALSH_TAPE_CUT_AREA`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Receipts are generated on stdout and bind the five package files by SHA256; default replay writes nothing.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

One sequential head, s carried field registers, fixed input-independent linear control, in-place outputs and independent restored scratch are hypotheses. Multiple heads/tapes, changed placement, nonlinear encoding or source-dependent side information can escape the result. No production layout, bit-cost encoding, rounded implementation, complete native caller, optimal schedule, selected cold replay or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. The written proof supplies universal quantifiers; finite checks corroborate it. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No required local package check was deferred to CI.

## Related open work

- #4192 lowers a Beneš compiler with explicit sequential scans; this package proves a different lower bound for repeated Walsh data transforms.
- #5974 establishes selected native identities and all-width lifting; it does not price the one-head layout studied here. Its result is cited as context, not rechecked.
- #5945 constructs a cheaper signed Hadamard connector in a recursive-query alphabet; its primitive-call price is distinct from physical cell movement.
- #5946 classifies restricted second-input Fourier reads; this package keeps all columns arbitrary and changes the physical tape layout.
- #5967 bounds Clifford tensor-independence width; its Gram threshold is distinct from spatial tape cut ranks.
- #5981 counts internally restoring moving Gaussian stages; its block-permutation endpoint and stage count differ from local linear tape travel.
- #5985 improves a G20 carry leaf's physical transition and storage bounds; it does not implement or bound an in-place Walsh transform.
- #5987 prices unit head movement for a skew-radix cached chirp table; it studies read-only table traversal rather than the Walsh data-transform cut profile.

The live open list and Discussion claims were refreshed before committing, alongside merged-PR and all-main README searches. No PR studying the same spatial-cut formula was found within that coverage. Unpublished work and arbitrary diffs are outside it; the sparse local note cache is incomplete. Completion refresh inspected all 11 account open PRs created since the CLAIM, including this PR. The ten other submissions report no matching spatial-cut formula; no extra computations were run to compare their results.

## Open next questions

1. Construct matching-order restored head schedules for these layouts, beginning with complete consecutive column programs. The present literal programs establish feasibility, not optimal growth.
2. Bind one actual caller's layout, carried-register budget and extra head/tape channels to decide whether this restricted obstruction applies.

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.
